verdict.rationale: Rippling's marketing describes built-in AI that does tasks inside the product: building reports and dashboards from prompts like "Show me headcount vs plan," letting employees get answers and submit qualifying life events, and automatically reviewing dependent documents to approve coverage. These are scattered, feature-specific one-line claims, not a documented general-purpose assistant you can hand arbitrary tasks to. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on a general assistant and its scope of delegable actions, coverage across HR/IT/finance modules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
